title: Spatial logical toy
abstract: A spatial logical toy comprises eighteen elements: two sets of eight identical cube-shaped pieces with integrated cam mechanisms, plus two central connecting elements. The cams feature curved hollow surfaces that interlock, enabling rotatable assembly along spatial axes. A single spring-loaded screw provides fixation while maintaining rotational freedom. Surface markings enable numerous puzzle configurations for stimulating logical thinking.
gist: Erno Rubik's US patent on the cube puzzle mechanism: cube-shaped pieces with cam protrusions interlock through curved surfaces, held by central connectors and a single spring-loaded screw, letting each face rotate freely without separate hardware.
